agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression 'copy issue672': sqlparse/tokens.py _TokenType.__getattr__ was missing its guard against dunder attribute names (the comment '# don't mess with dunder' was present but the actual check had been dropped). This caused any dunder lookup (e.g. __deepcopy__, __copy__, __getstate__ used internally by copy.deepcopy/pickle) to synthesize a new non-callable _TokenType instance instead of raising AttributeError, which made copy.deepcopy()/pickle on Token objects fail with 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable'. Restored the guard: `if name.startswith('__') and name.endswith('__'): raise AttributeError` before creating a new token type. Verified via manual testing that copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, and pickle round-trips on Token types now work correctly, that direct access to dunder attributes raises AttributeError as expected, that normal (non-dunder) attribute creation on Token types still works (e.g. Token.Foo.Bar), and that sqlparse.format() still parses/formats SQL correctly, confirming no regression to existing behavior.
